name: PSD Price Table for Elementor
author: DeadSoul

sections.description:
PSD Price Table for Elementor adds a powerful and flexible pricing table element to the Elementor page builder, allowing you to showcase your service plans beautifully.

✨ Features:

  • Create unlimited pricing tables inside Elementor.
  • Customize sections like:
    • Plan name
    • Price
    • Currency symbol
    • Billing period
    • Title
    • Description
    • Feature list
    • Call-to-action button
  • Full styling options for each section.
  • Use any color or Google Font.
  • Build modern, professional designs without writing a single line of code.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to any Elementor page, search for PSD Price Table, and drag it to your layout.
  4. Start customizing your pricing table widget!
sections.faq:
Does it require Elementor Pro?

No, it works perfectly with the free version of Elementor.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release – Full pricing table widget with extensive styling options.
